speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower abdominal pain. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and what it feels like?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular torsion. Based on your age, the sudden onset of pain while playing football, and the risk factors for sexually transmitted infections, I need to confirm if you have noticed any swelling, discoloration of the scrotum, or nausea/vomiting. Please also tell me if you have noticed any discharge or sores from your genitals.
